thread:
incident-bot: Pager: GPU-CAPACITY-ALERT triggered for cluster-prod-europe (priority: P1). Queue length for gpu-inference-service > 900, autoscaler failing to attach new node groups. Alert: autoscaler:AddNodeError

alice.lin: I'm on it. seeing rapid queue growth in the dashboard, token ingest up 3x in last 10m.

ben.p: Repro dashboard link: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/cluster-prod-europe?panel=queue-length — nodes at 0/48 GPUs free.

carla_ops: We're getting AttachNodeGroup error from controller: "AccessDenied: iam:PassRole" when trying to create ASG with launch template. full log: `E0503 14:04:12 autoscaler.go:452] failed to create nodegroup: AttachNodeGroup failed: AccessDenied: iam:PassRole`

david_oncall: @carla_ops thanks. Pager duty routed to me. I'll start escalation if we can't get a quick mitigation. Any affected customer lists?

frank_support: Currently two high-traffic customers showing 500s and queued requests: cust-acme and cust-neon. Support page tracking: https://redwood.internal/support/incidents/1743219876

eve_sre: Quick hypothesis: launch template role change rolled out at 13:58 UTC to include new KMS key; new role not allowed to be passed by autoscaler instance profile role. That matches AccessDenied: iam:PassRole.

alice.lin: Can someone confirm the launch template change? ben, do you have the deploy logs?

ben.p: Confirmed: LT version v42 rolled at 13:58 by infra-deploy-bot. Rollout note: "LT role: arn:aws:iam::123:role/instance-gpu-role-v2". Old role was instance-gpu-role-v1. The autoscaler IAM policy allows passrole for v1 only.

carla_ops: That would explain failures to create new nodegroups and taint application. Node creation attempts are stuck retrying.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2025-042-009 (P1). On-call: david_oncall. Handoff: @david_oncall.

david_oncall: Immediate mitigation options: 1) Roll back launch template to v41, 2) Update autoscaler role to allow PassRole to v2, 3) Temporarily open scale-up by manual provisioning of nodes. Which is fastest?

eve_sre: Easiest short-term is rollback LT to v41; infra can push rollback in minutes. Updating IAM might require ticket and approval (~30-45m). Manual provision will take ~15m but needs precreated AMI/instance-profile, and might be manual labor.

alice.lin: What's impact window if we rollback? Any risk to running pods?

ben.p: LT rollback is safe; it just affects new instances. No replacement of existing nodes. However, any instance-level change that happened in v42 (like KMS mount) won't be present. Confirm with security if that matters.

carla_ops: I'm coordinating with infra to rollback. Initiating rollback now. command: `./infra/lt-rollback --cluster cluster-prod-europe --lt-name gpu-lt --to-version v41`

incident-bot: Deploy bot: starting rollback job #98732 by carla_ops at 14:08:32 UTC.

frank_support: Update: cust-acme requests have median latency 12s and 5% 500s. We should prepare customer comms if remediation takes >30m.

alice.lin: While rollback runs, let's enable aggressive queue shedding for non-critical routes to protect high-priority customers. Rule change: rate-limit embed endpoints to 10 qps per key for next 20m. carla_ops please apply.

carla_ops: Applying temporary rate-limit rule. `PATCH /config/ratelimits` payload posted. Confirmed: rule active at 14:10:01 UTC.

ben.p: Rollback job completed at 14:11:05 UTC. Autoscaler now attempting create again. Logs: `Attempting CreateNodeGroup with launchTemplate v41`

david_oncall: Monitoring creation. Any failures?

eve_sre: Nodegroup attach progressed to 80% then failed at health check; new error: `TaintMismatch: expected taint gpu=true:NoSchedule present on node` — looks like v41 nodes have different taint behavior? Strange.

alice.lin: That could be because v42 earlier changed kubelet extraArgs. Did rollback fully revert bootstrap user-data? Check cloud-init in new instance.

carla_ops: Confirming cloud-init shows `--register-with-taints=gpu=true:NoSchedule` present. v41 should also register same taint. Maybe kubelet version mismatch causing taint not applied before pod scheduling.

ben.p: Checking autoscaler logs: it's repeatedly marking nodegroup Created but not Ready. Pod backlog still growing. Queue at 1300.

incident-bot: Pager: Update. P1 incident active. Next check-in at +15m or when status changes.

david_oncall: At this point we have two failed attempts: IAM PassRole then taint/registration timing. We need a short-lived manual run of dedicated GPU instances and add them to cluster with correct taints to drain queue. I'll coordinate with infra to spin up 4 pre-baked GPU instances and attach them manually.

carla_ops: Spinning manual instances: `aws ec2 run-instances --launch-template LaunchTemplateId=lt-0abcd --count 4 --instance-type p4d.24xlarge --iam-instance-profile Name=instance-gpu-role-v1`

eve_sre: Make sure nodes join with label `node.kubernetes.io/instance-type=gpu` and taint `gpu=true:NoSchedule`. Use this cloud-init snippet: ```
#cloud-config
core: 
  - |
    #!/bin/bash
    /usr/local/bin/register-node --taints gpu=true:NoSchedule --labels instance-type=gpu
```

frank_support: Support notes: cust-acme still impacted. ETA for manual nodes to be ready ~12-18 minutes. I'll send initial customer ack and link to status page.

alice.lin: Also add a fallback model routing rule: divert 30% of cust-acme traffic to medium-latency instances in us-west to reduce queue. We need product approval? For emergency routing we can do auto-fallback for P1.

ben.p: Applying routing fallback via feature-flag: feature.fallback.routing=true for cust-acme. Confirmed at 14:21:02 UTC.

carla_ops: Manual instances are in pending. Cloud-init logs show registration attempt. One node failed kubelet start: `kubelet: failed to start: missing containerd socket` — need to ensure AMI includes container runtime.

david_oncall: That's annoying. Use backup AMI id ami-0gpu-ready-202503 with validated runtime. Spawning again with that AMI.

carla_ops: Relaunched manual instances with ami-0gpu-ready-202503, all 4 coming up. At 14:35 UTC, three nodes Ready and tainted. Autoscaler/pods scheduling onto them.

ben.p: Queue decreased from 1300 -> 420 in 6 minutes, token throughput stable. 500s dropped to 0.8% for cust-acme.

frank_support: Customers notified: initial ack sent at 14:14. Follow-up message at 14:38: "We deployed temporary nodes to relieve capacity; some requests may be routed to fallback instances. Monitoring continues."

alice.lin: Next steps: 1) Fix autoscaler IAM passrole policy to include instance-gpu-role-v2 (short-term policy update), 2) Reconcile launch template differences that affected taint registration (ensure consistent bootstrap scripts), 3) Replace manual nodes with properly autoscaled ones, 4) Postmortem.

eve_sre: I'll open a security-approved policy change PR now and kick off infra ticket to reconcile LT bootstrap. PR: https://git.internal/infra/iam/PR-4567. Expect review + merge in ~20-30m.

david_oncall: For incident timeline and customer impact: start 14:03 UTC (alert), mitigation complete (queue steady) 14:38 UTC, full auto-recovery contingent on policy rollout. I'll update incident doc.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2025-042-009 updated: mitigated -> manual relief nodes added, monitoring.

carla_ops: I've scheduled a canary for autoscaler with updated PassRole at 15:05 UTC after policy merge. Will validate creating a new nodegroup and ensure taint applied correctly.

frank_support: Final customer update draft: "Resolved temporary capacity issue. We added relief capacity and will follow up with root cause and timeline. No customer data was exposed." Shared to legal for signoff.

alice.lin: Triage notes for postmortem: - root causes: LT role change without autoscaler passrole update + bootstrap divergence causing taint timing mismatch. - mitigation: LT rollback attempted, manual GPU nodes added, routing fallback for high-priority customers. - action items: update CI to enforce PassRole checks for LT changes, add autoscaler integration tests for taint timing, improve rollback automation.

david_oncall: I'm handing off to eve_sre for follow-up and postmortem. I'll update PD and close after follow-ups. Handoff complete at 14:45 UTC.

eve_sre: Taking ownership for postmortem and follow-ups. I'll coordinate with infra and security. Thanks everyone. :heart:
